title: Experts disagree on runtime/claude-plugin/skills generated folders
context:
Chief architect: Both hold; keep both. The drift guard is the lead because it is the only thing that stops the committed copy and the source drifting, and it only guards if the gate job requires it. Self-contained skill folders (application-architect 8) remain a must and are proven by the PLG-10 check in build.py.

Target: runtime/claude-plugin/skills generated folders
- integration-architect: the committed generated skills drift from plugins/discovery source when someone edits one side only; the discovery-plugin CI job's rebuild plus git diff --exit-code (including untracked files) is the only guard and the gate job must require it
- application-architect: each generated skill folder is self-contained (its shared references and scripts copied in by build.py, PLG-10) and never reads from plugins/discovery/ at run time, since plugins/ is not in the published plugin or npm package
